page.overview:
Who is Harold Clemmens?

Harold Clemmens is a character created by C. J. Henderson as part of his Arkham Detective Agency series.

At the time the stories are set, Harold Clemmens is the president of Miskatonic University, Arkham's premier higher-learning institution. C. J. Henderson describes him as:

Despite his appearance, he is portrayed as being something of a visionary, making such decisions as retaining the services of a private detective agency: not only as physical security, but to monitor Arkham's underworld for rumours of any criminal activities directed towards the university. Highly intelligent, he also appears to have at least a rudimentary knowledge of the gods and monsters of the Mythos, as shown in the short story "Cruelty".

Category:Characters Originating From Expanded Mythos Works Category:Humans
